normalization: The Internet Archive's own text layer (_djvu.txt) as served, under original/<identifier>/, copied to text/<slug>.ocr.txt with line endings normalized. The PDF of each item is held by reference at its Archive URL and not copied. No text was corrected by hand; the loci keep the OCR's readings. The Archive's text layer of this black-letter facsimile is largely unreadable; the scan is the witness, and the preface to the Apocalypse and the table of books are read from the pages.
scope: The facsimile whole, held for the table of books (Hebrews, James, Jude and the Apocalypse set apart and unnumbered) and the 1522 preface to the Apocalypse.
why_seated: Standing made into typography: stratum 3.6. The preface's wording enters the study only when read from the pages of this scan.
